setup: Create a Seeed account, enrol under Affiliate Settings, then copy a referral link. Put the query parameter name in "param" and your code in "affiliateId". Verified 2026-09-17: 3% base, XIAO 8%, 45-day cookie, $50 minimum, quarterly PayPal.

CONFIRM THE NETWORK FIRST. Two routes conflict: the Awin merchant profile 82721 lists Elecrow as active (5-10%, 30-day cookie), but elecrow.com/affiliate.html advertises up to 20% and its Apply button points to ShareASale, which Awin folded in late 2025. Ask marketing@elecrow.com which network is live, then paste the ID. If it is Awin, the stored template is right; if not, replace it. Partner-seller marketplace products carry commission restrictions that are only visible inside the network portal.
Same Awin publisher ID as Elecrow, once CircuitMess approves you. Verified 2026-09-17: 30-day cookie; rate not published.
After approval, copy a referral link from the BixGrow dashboard. Put the query parameter name in "param" and your code in "affiliateId". Verified 2026-09-17: 2%, 30-day cookie.
Activate in your DFRobot account portal, then copy a referral link. Verified 2026-09-17: 3% rising to 6% and 8% with volume, $50 minimum, 30-day lock after shipping.

GL.iNet runs tracks on Awin, Tradedoubler and Impact, all 'up to 10%'. Join through one of them, then paste that network's deep-link template here with {id} and {url} placeholders. Verified 2026-09-17.

Email support@lab401.com to join; choose the 10% commission / 0% discount split. Flipper Zero products pay nothing. Verified 2026-09-17: monthly bank transfer from €10. Useful for HackRF, Proxmark, Chameleon, Bus Pirate and Electronic Cats links in Europe.

India-based reseller that stocks Great Scott Gadgets (HackRF Pro). Open self-serve signup on an OpenCart affiliate module; the commission rate is not published and lives in their terms document, so read it or email before activating. Low priority: Indian shipping and pricing suit few of our readers.

Amazon Associates. The parameter is always "tag"; paste your store id (e.g. gadgetssh-20) into affiliateId. CAUTION: the commission rates could NOT be verified on 2026-09-17 — every route to the fee schedule sits behind a sign-in wall, so the often-quoted 2.5-4% for electronics is unconfirmed. Check the real rate card inside an Associates account before counting on any number. Confirmed from public terms: 24-hour cookie, $10 minimum by direct deposit, paid about 60 days after month end, and the account is closed if it makes no qualifying sale within 180 days of approval. Link only to official brand stores — this category is full of clones, and RTL-SDR Blog publicly warns about fake V4 dongles on Amazon.

AliExpress Portals. After approval, copy a tracking link and put its parameter name in "param" and your id in "affiliateId". Verified 2026-09-17: roughly 3-4% on consumer electronics, 3-day cookie. Useful because M5Stack, LILYGO and Heltec all run official AliExpress stores. Link ONLY to verified official brand stores, never search results — counterfeits are rife.
